arguments.name: responseParameters
arguments.description: (Optional) Map of parameters (paths, query strings and headers) of the Gateway Response.

arguments.name: responseTemplates
arguments.description: (Optional) Map of templates used to transform the response body.

arguments.name: responseType
arguments.description: (Required) Response type of the associated GatewayResponse.

arguments.name: restApiId
arguments.description: (Required) String identifier of the associated REST API.

arguments.name: statusCode
arguments.description: (Optional) HTTP status code of the Gateway Response.
